name: Yahenni
description: Yahenni is a flamboyant aetherborn vampire, investor, philanthropist and socialite of Ghirapur who aided the Renegades despite having only weeks to live.

bio.text: Knowing they had fifty-four days left, Yahenni refused to use essence draining, and at their party helped Chandra and Nissa learn that Pia Nalaar was held in Dhund prison.

citations.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

bio.text: Enraged by the Consulate after a dying convict jailed for petty theft died, Yahenni later drained an enforcer's essence to save Nived, which extended their life for twelve days.

citations.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.
"In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

bio.text: Yahenni blackmailed Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, and Gonti sent them to warn the renegades that the Consulate was coming.

citations.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.
"In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

bio.text: Yahenni then offered their penthouse as a hideout for the Gatewatch and killed another enforcer to protect them, extending their life to twenty-two days.

bio.text: Yahenni later tracked aether flow with Nissa, and after the revolution swore not to feed on others again.

bio.text: At their Penultimate Party Yahenni left their fortune to their aetherborn family and the inventor Sana Ahir, gave Nissa a pendant, and died peacefully on the roof surrounded by friends.

timeline.summary: Yahenni dresses for his party, knowing he has fifty-four days to live.
timeline.quote: I have fifty-four days left to live.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Depala hints that Yahenni could extend his life by essence draining, and he refuses.
timeline.quote: I'm not willing to go those lengths, Depala.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri tells Yahenni that Pia Nalaar has been captured and asks what he knows.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was captured, you know.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps that Yahenni would help if it were his parent.
timeline.quote: If it was your parent you'd help us,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: A dying aetherborn is carried in on a chair to attend their penultimate party.
timeline.quote: It's my penultimate party!

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni takes Nissa to the roof and explains that aetherborn are the city's own natural beings.
timeline.quote: We are the city. I'm made of aether, and one day, I'll return to it.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that this world is structured and cyclical.
timeline.quote: This world is structured. Cyclical.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: A Consulate prison enforcer tries to force a bathroom door to seize a wanted convict.
timeline.quote: A wanted convict is currently barricaded behind that door.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
timeline.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni reads the enforcer's energy to learn Pia is held in Dhund prison.
timeline.quote: Dhund prison?

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds an escaped aetherborn convict dying in the bathroom with one minute left.
timeline.quote: I've got about a minute left,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The dying aetherborn dies, their aether rising in vapor, after saying they had a good run.
timeline.quote: Their dermis crumbles and the contained aether escapes and rises in a gentle vapor to the ceiling.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds the dead aetherborn was jailed for petty theft and is enraged at the Consulate.
timeline.quote: They shouldn't have been sent to prison in the first place.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni considers hunting down the Consulate with essence draining but decides the time will come later.
timeline.quote: No. The time will come for that.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni announces the party of a lifetime after the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: I'm hosting the party of a lifetime here after the conclusion of the Inventors' Fair.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni, minutes from death, stumbles through the curfew-empty Weldfast looking for someone to be with them.
timeline.quote: It is dark and I am the only person shambling under the eaves of the Weldfast.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni realizes they will die alone and panics, then smells a familiar friend.
timeline.quote: I'm going to die alone.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds Nived painting the renegade leaking spire over torn Consulate banners at the Museum of Invention.
timeline.quote: From across the street I can make out a human figure putting the final touches on their graffiti.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni apologizes to Nived for canceling his catering of their Penultimate Party at the last moment.
timeline.quote: "I'm sorry...I canceled...less than a day prior to when my party was scheduled..."

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The enforcer repeatedly shocks and kicks the unconscious Nived while demanding what Yahenni knows about six renegade sympathizers, including Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for six individuals that are sympathetic to the renegades' cause.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni drains the enforcer's essence, killing them, feeling their death, and restoring their own body for twelve days.
timeline.quote: I claw my right hand and pull from the enforcer's neck.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni realizes they have killed a person and are a murderer, but rationalizes that they may live by killing bad people.
timeline.quote: ...I am a murderer.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni hides Nived behind a stall and decides to find the renegades and the criminal's daughter, then seek Gonti's help.
timeline.quote: I need to find the renegades.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni gets Nived home and reaches Gonti's palace-like hideout, where Gonti is bathing in aether attar, a metal lump visible on their chest.
timeline.quote: Gonti sits submerged, their face covered with a gilded mask.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
timeline.quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gonti realizes Yahenni is an essence drainer and reveals having employed two before.
timeline.quote: "Essence drainers are rare," Gonti replies, "I've only ever had two in my employment.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
timeline.quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni goes to the Statuary Garden and climbs a ladder up a Vedalken inventor's statue where they sense the hidden renegades.
timeline.quote: I walk casually toward the statue and start to climb a ladder around the back.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
timeline.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
timeline.quote: My penthouse is safe.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
timeline.quote: And I jump down.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The enforcer's cruiser crashes into another statue; Yahenni's life is extended to twenty-two days.
timeline.quote: I now have twenty-two days left to live.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy, telling them they are her friend; Yahenni resolves to do good with their remaining days.
timeline.quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Yahenni confirm an unusual flux of aether is being diverted from the Aether Hub to the Spire's reservoir.
timeline.quote: Miss Nissa and I have recently determined an unusual flux of aether being diverted to that particular reservoir from the Aether Hub.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni, dressed by Depala, says they will not feed on others again and goes down to face their party.
timeline.quote: And I am not a killer.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: At the party, Yahenni announces their will, leaving half their savings to their aetherborn family and the rest to inventor Sana Ahir.
timeline.quote: "My other half of savings goes to you, red-scarf-wearing human inventor in the corner!"

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa channels land energy to ease Yahenni's pain and tells them that aetherborn are the substance connecting the Multiverse and that she is from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You are what connects the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Yahenni gives Nissa a pendant necklace with a sapphire from Lathnu.
timeline.quote: Nissa holds out a delicate hand to take the necklace.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Yahenni dies peacefully on the roof beneath the Great Conduit, surrounded by their family and friends.
timeline.quote: I dissipate into the endless sky above

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: In meditation Nissa witnesses a new aetherborn form from aether and guides them to the other aetherborn, hearing an echo of Yahenni.
timeline.quote: The aetherborn looked at their hands, then at Nissa's flowers.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Facing the end of their life, Yahenni absorbs the energy of Consulate enforcers and aligns with the Renegades.
timeline.quote: Yahenni chose to extend their life by absorbing the energy of a few of them

citation.text: "Yahenni", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the revolution Yahenni holds the Penultimate Party and chooses to meet their end.
timeline.quote: Yahenni held what they called their “Penultimate Party,” a final gathering of friends, allies, and admirers

citation.text: "Yahenni", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Yahenni calls her a dear friend.
relations.quote: My dear friend and ace pilot Depala
